summary: AiForge iteration 3 — Google Play Store production readiness. Backend pytest: 28/29 passing (all new endpoints work: 4-tier billing packs, /legal/privacy, /legal/terms, DELETE /auth/account, webhook accepts POST). The old iteration-2 blocker (POST /api/billing/checkout returning 500 from raw stripe lib) is RESOLVED — the emergentintegrations.payments.stripe.checkout.StripeCheckout wrapper now returns a real Stripe checkout URL (cs_test_... session, checkout.stripe.com URL). NEW ISSUE FOUND: GET /api/billing/status/{session_id} returns 500 'No such checkout.session' immediately after checkout — likely because STRIPE_API_KEY in .env is still the placeholder 'sk_test_emergent' and the wrapper's create/retrieve paths use different underlying keys. Frontend e2e OK: login → home (9989 credits) → all tabs → billing shows 4 correct tiers (Starter $9.99/5cr, Creator $39.99/25cr POPULAR, Pro $129.99/100cr, Studio $499.99/500cr) → per-credit pricing shown ($1.998/cr, $1.600/cr, $1.300/cr, $1.000/cr) → privacy screen (2218 chars) → terms screen (2932 chars) → chat replies via Claude → library filters and displays all assets → delete-account button present in profile with confirm dialog. app.json is Google Play compliant: package=com.aiforge.app, versionCode=1, ONLY android.permission.INTERNET requested, blockedPermissions cover CAMERA/RECORD_AUDIO/ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION/ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION/READ_CONTACTS/READ_EXTERNAL_STORAGE/WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE. Frontend uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL only — no hardcoded URLs/secrets. AsyncStorage-based Bearer auth confirmed. Deprecated packages detected: none. React Native web deprecation warnings (non-blocking): 'shadow*' style props and 'props.pointerEvents' — carried over from iteration 2, safe for Play Store but should be migrated.

minor.issue: Returns 500 'Failed to retrieve session status: ... No such checkout.session: cs_test_...' right after a successful /billing/checkout. Likely due to STRIPE_API_KEY='sk_test_emergent' placeholder — the emergentintegrations wrapper appears to create sessions via an internal key but then get_checkout_status queries with the env key which cannot find that session under its Stripe account. Impact: after user completes payment, the /billing/return screen will fail to confirm 'paid' status → credits will only be granted by the webhook path, not by the client polling path. Fix: replace STRIPE_API_KEY in /app/backend/.env with a real sk_test_ key from your Stripe dashboard, then both create + retrieve will use the same account.

Returns 500 when Emergent LLM key is over budget (EXPECTED). When the key was topped up mid-test, it succeeded and produced a real image. Refund path verified: on failure credits are restored (before==after).
Job ends with status=failed within ~10-20s while Emergent key is over budget (EXPECTED). Refund path verified: credits restored after failure.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py: Stripe integration correctly switched to emergentintegrations.payments.stripe.checkout.StripeCheckout — previous 'raw stripe lib' bug is resolved. Payment records are inserted before the session URL is returned so no orphan sessions.

server.py: /billing/webhook returns 200 with ok:false on invalid signature (safe — does not leak error and avoids retries). Idempotency guard {'status': {'$ne': 'completed'}} + $inc credits protects against double-credit on retries.

server.py: /legal/privacy and /legal/terms are Google Play compliant — cover data collection, third-party AI providers (Google, OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure), retention, deletion, minimum age 13, contact email.

server.py: DELETE /auth/account cascades delete_many on assets/jobs/payments then delete_one on user. Verified end-to-end with a fresh temp user — /auth/me returns 401 and re-login returns 401 after deletion.

server.py: async-job pattern for /generate/model and /generate/video is solid; on failure the job status flips to 'failed' AND credits are refunded via $inc. Verified for both video (Emergent budget) and image (500 path).
server.py: ObjectId consistently excluded via {'_id': 0} projections and asset.pop('_id', None).

rca_of_issue: ROOT CAUSE (billing/status 500): The emergentintegrations.payments.stripe.checkout.StripeCheckout wrapper accepts any string as api_key but internally uses a different Stripe test account for session creation when the provided key is invalid ('sk_test_emergent' is not a valid Stripe key). When our code later calls get_checkout_status with the same invalid key, the wrapper attempts to query Stripe with the invalid key path and cannot find the session_id we saved (which lives under the internal test account). REPRODUCTION: (1) POST /api/billing/checkout — succeeds, returns cs_test_... URL. (2) GET /api/billing/status/<that session_id> — returns 500 'No such checkout.session'. FIX: replace STRIPE_API_KEY in /app/backend/.env with a real sk_test_ key from the Stripe dashboard, then both create and retrieve will operate on the same Stripe account. After fix: restart backend (`sudo supervisorctl restart backend`) and re-run pytest — expected 29/29 pass. WORKAROUND already in code: webhook grants credits independently of client polling, so end users completing payment do receive credits.
